captions.name: Lines
captions.line: Short lines on a soft plate, the key word glowing.

captions.name: Punch
captions.line: One or two bold words at a time, outlined.

captions.name: Two-Font
captions.line: Plain capitals, with the key word huge in an italic font.

captions.name: One Word
captions.line: One big word at a time, switching instantly.

captions.name: Big Word
captions.line: The line small, its key word huge underneath.

captions.name: Pill
captions.line: Short phrases, the key word in a solid pill.

captions.name: Editorial
captions.line: A small spaced-out line over one big italic word.

captions.name: Steps
captions.line: Words step down the frame like stairs.

effects.name: Word Stamp
effects.line: One spoken word stamped on screen.

effects.name: Giant Words
effects.line: Your words huge, one at a time.

effects.name: Icon Strike
effects.line: A crossed-out icon when you say no to something.

effects.name: Page Scroll
effects.line: Your web page scrolling by. Needs a screenshot from you.

effects.name: Live Markup
effects.line: A circle drawn on your screenshot. Needs a screenshot from you.

effects.name: Keycaps
effects.line: Keys typing out your keyword, like SITE.

effects.name: Receipt
effects.line: A short list printing line by line.

effects.name: Title Card
effects.line: A short title card with a few of your words.

effects.name: Big Number
effects.line: One big number you said, with a label.

effects.name: Pie
effects.line: A pie that fills to the share you said.

effects.name: List Tracker
effects.line: A header that counts through your list and stays up.

effects.name: Snap Zoom
effects.line: A slow push in, then a quick snap on your most important word.

effects.name: Quote Card
effects.line: Words someone said, typed out in quotes.

effects.name: Pinned Line
effects.line: One short line pinned at the top the whole time.

effects.name: Cover Story
effects.line: Your opening as a magazine cover.

effects.name: Highlighter
effects.line: A highlighter sweeps a line on your screenshot. Needs a screenshot from you.

effects.name: Glass Word
effects.line: A huge frosted-glass word behind you.

effects.name: Note Wall
effects.line: Paper notes with your words stick up around you.

effects.name: Arrow Note
effects.line: A handwritten note with an arrow pointing at something.

effects.name: Comment Box
effects.line: Your keyword types into a comment and a heart pops.

effects.name: Giant Number
effects.line: Your list number fills the screen with a pop, covering you for about half a second.

transitions.name: Flash
transitions.line: A warm bright flash on the cut.

transitions.name: Whip
transitions.line: A fast sideways whip with blur.

transitions.name: Zoom
transitions.line: A quick zoom through the cut.

transitions.name: Spin
transitions.line: A small spin through the cut.

transitions.name: Iris
transitions.line: A ring closes on you and opens again.

styles.name: Clean Talk
styles.line: One word at a time in your brand color, low and clean, with a hook title over your head at the start. The everyday look.

styles.name: Big Energy
styles.line: Bold one-or-two-word captions, zoom punches and big words. Fast and loud.

styles.name: Soft Story
styles.line: Calm and warm: words that step down softly, the key word in your second font, gentle moves. For stories and trust.

styles.name: Show and Tell
styles.line: Clear captions on a dark strip plus graphics for your numbers, lists and screenshots. For teaching and ads.

fonts.line: Inter, with Instrument Serif for key words.
